newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health invests $51.7 mln in FOHP.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health invests $51.7 mln in FOHP.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc on Friday said it has completed a $51.7 million investment in FOHP Inc, a managed care company in Red Bank, New Jersey.
Foundation received FOHP convertible debentures for its investment. The bonds convert into as much as 71 percent of FOHP's outstanding equity.

FOHP is owned by a consortium of New Jersey hospitals and physicians. Its health maintenance organization (HMO) unit, First Option Health Plan of New Jersey Inc, has 190,957 HMO members in New Jersey, 160,888 are in commercial programs and 30,069 are in Medicare and Medicaid.

In addition to the investment, Foundation will provide a variety of management services to FOHP, including provider contracting, utilization review and quality assurance, employee relations, sales and marketing, and strategic planning, among others.
FOHP will pay Foundation two percent of its premium revenue for these services. Foundation may also provide information systems and claims processing services to FOHP.
